title: Create: Construction Compatibility
description: This datapack adds the ability to smelt crushed ore from the Create mod in furnaces from the Tinkers' Construct mod.
body:
RU: Данный датапак добавляет возможность переплавки дроблёной руды из мода Create в печах из мода Tinkers' Construct

Зависимости:

Tinkers' Construct [https://modrinth.com/mod/tinkers-construct]

Create [https://modrinth.com/mod/create]

EN: This datapack adds the ability to smelt crushed ore from the Create mod in furnaces from the Tinkers' Construct mod.

Dependencies:

Tinkers' Construct [https://modrinth.com/mod/tinkers-construct]
